verdict.rationale: An admin console for a network connectivity platform could plausibly offer AI-generated insights from tailnet data, so this axis applies. The evidence shows no such in-product capability. The related AI items don't qualify: the Aperture gateway inspects and modifies LLM requests, and the Tailscale skill lets external coding agents work with Tailscale configuration. Neither produces AI insights or suggestions from the user's own data inside Tailscale.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
